author: Widogeist
body: You get a [steward pet](https://orna.guide/search?searchstr=steward).  There are 5 total steward pets you can get, the one you get is random.  You used to be able to get duplicate pets but it doesn't look like you can anymore which is nice, you're guaranteed to get a new pet each time.  You can get more candles with gauntlet completion rewards.

author: pika_buu
body:
As has already been stated you will get one of the steward pets.  
They are:

* [https://playorna.com/codex/followers/steward-cactus/](https://playorna.com/codex/followers/steward-cactus/)
* [https://playorna.com/codex/followers/steward-dragon/](https://playorna.com/codex/followers/steward-dragon/)
* [https://playorna.com/codex/followers/steward-gazer/](https://playorna.com/codex/followers/steward-gazer/)
* [https://playorna.com/codex/followers/steward-golem/](https://playorna.com/codex/followers/steward-golem/)
* [https://playorna.com/codex/followers/steward-wolf/](https://playorna.com/codex/followers/steward-wolf/)
